{{Quote|No ''Millennium Falcon'' for us this trip, Chewie ... we're going to be heroes on this tub of Luke's!|Han Solo|<ref name="BMtC" />}}
This '''starship''' was piloted by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on a mission for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to deliver pre-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] [[micro-book]]s to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Harix]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Accompanying Luke were the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Skywalker avoided a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] patrol and landed near the [[school]] where [[Myoris Lin]] taught, hiding the vessel. They discovered that Lin was already the target of an Imperial raid led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stafuv Rahz]], who captured the teacher and her students, except Lin's own son [[Berd Lin|Berd]]. Berd departed with Skywalker aboard the starship, meeting with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] at a prearranged rendezvous. Organa approved of Berd's rescue plan, which would use [[Deep Space Target Practice Unit|target drones]] modified to transmit false [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] profiles to distract the Imperial forces, and Skywalker, Organa, and Berd recruited [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and several other [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to assist in the rescue. The target drones were loaded aboard Skywalker's starship, and Solo and Chewbacca left behind the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to accompany Skywalker, Organa, and Berd aboard the vessel. When the ship emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Skywalker's ship deployed the drones, which appeared on Imperial sensors to be a huge battle [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The ship landed on Harix, and Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca ventured forth to deal with a group of TIE fighters lying in wait behind Harix's [[Talhu Slotted Peaks]]. After neutralizing the fighters, Chewbacca returned to inform Organa, who flew with Berd aboard the starship and led the other freighter pilots to the school, where they rejoined Skywalker and Chewbacca and rescued Lin and the children.<ref name="BMtC" />

[[File:Promo1.png|thumb|left|Ship in promo similar to the one in ''Bring Me the Children''.]]
